items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I forget the song that Beeny Goodman had when he had the Camel Show.

ctx.x: They say, 'Hey, how yall get those songs?' You know, we were getting them before anybody, you know.
Because we had one song -- I forget the song that Beeny Goodman had when he had the Camel Show.
He had to borrow Ella Fitzgerald to do the song on his show -- our arrangements, because --
